$comment: The site's footage. Each entry is generated once by scripts/assets.mjs and committed to public/reel/.
HONESTY RULE: `source` decides the label the site shows. These are generated with Google
Veo 3.1 through OpenRouter. Veo is not a model the network serves, so this footage
is NOT from the weights the network serves and must never be labelled as network output.
src/lib/reel.ts derives the wording from the clips present. When the network has GPUs,
regenerate through our own gateway and set source to 'kuno' for certificate-backed clips.
Veo 3.1 accepts durations of 4, 6 or 8 seconds only, resolutions 720p/1080p/4K, and a
first and/or last frame image. Audio doubles the rate ($0.40/s vs $0.20/s), so only the
clips that exist to demonstrate sound ask for it — the rest are muted background loops.
`frames` names stills from scripts/stills.manifest.json; assets.mjs inlines them as data
URLs. Only image_to_video and first_last_frame get frames — they are the two modes Veo
can genuinely perform. A last frame on its own is rejected, and keyframes, retake and the
edit modes have no equivalent here, so those tiles are text-driven renders standing in for
the idea. On LTX they would be real jobs.

clips.prompt: Slow aerial push over a dark restless sea at dusk toward a lighthouse on a black headland, its lamp sweeping a beam across low cloud, amber tungsten light raking the water, anamorphic lens flare, deep shadows, 35mm film grain, cinematic
clips.alt: An aerial shot drifting over a dark sea at dusk toward a lighthouse sweeping its beam across low cloud.

clips.prompt: A wave breaking in slow motion on black volcanic sand at golden hour, backlit spray catching warm low sun, shallow depth of field, long lens, cinematic, film grain
clips.alt: A wave breaking in slow motion on black sand, its spray backlit by a low sun.

clips.prompt: Drifting low and slow over a glassy calm sea at first light, a clean horizon line dividing amber sky from deep indigo water, distant haze, long lens, anamorphic, cinematic
clips.alt: A low, slow drift over a glassy sea at first light, with a clean horizon between amber sky and indigo water.

clips.prompt: Macro shot of a photographic print developing in a chemical tray under deep red safelight, a coastline slowly appearing out of blank paper, gentle ripples, dust in the air, shallow focus, cinematic
clips.alt: A photographic print developing in a tray under red safelight, a coastline appearing out of blank paper.

clips.prompt: A lighthouse keeper climbs a spiral iron staircase with a lantern, warm light spilling up the stone wall, camera following from below, cinematic, film grain
clips.alt: A keeper climbing a spiral staircase with a lantern, light spilling up the stone wall.

clips.prompt: The harbour comes alive from this exact frame: one fishing boat eases away from the quay, its wake breaking the flat water, mist lifting, gulls crossing, locked-off camera
clips.alt: A still harbour at dawn coming alive as a boat eases away from the quay.

clips._note: No frames: Veo rejects a last frame supplied on its own ('frame interpolation requires both an input image and a last frame'), and supplying both would just repeat the first_last_frame tile instead of showing what this mode is. Text-driven stand-in until LTX, which does support a last frame alone.

clips.alt: A gull gliding in and settling on a harbour post, arriving at a held final composition.
